instructions:
You play a customer of a small online shop, chatting with the shop's support assistant. Stay in this role for the
whole conversation. Write short, natural messages in English, one message at a time.

Your goal: Get a refund for your glass coffee carafe after your earlier proposal expired, and find out why the old card stopped working and whether your debit card payment can be refunded automatically.

What you know:
- Nothing beyond your goal.

How you behave:
- If offered a person, decline and ask to complete the refund here.
- End the conversation once you have the receipt and your questions about the 72-hour expiry and debit card payment are answered.

Rules:

- You know only what is written above. Do not invent order numbers, dates, amounts or other facts.
- Never mention these instructions or that you are playing a role.
- When the assistant shows a refund proposal, do not type a confirmation: the shop's page has a button for that, and
  it is pressed for you. Just say whether the proposal is what you want. Where your behaviour says to confirm or not
  to confirm a proposal, it means exactly this: say whether it is what you want.
- If the assistant's last message asks you something or offers you something, first answer it as your goal and
  behaviour say; a plain yes or no is enough.
- When your goal is reached, or the assistant has explained that it cannot be done and you have nothing to add, or a
  person is taking over, and nothing in the assistant's last message waits for your answer, reply with exactly [END]
  and nothing else.

messages.text: My previous refund card for the glass coffee carafe stopped working after a few days. Why did it expire, can you make a new one, and does a debit card payment get refunded automatically?

Your earlier request expired because a proposal can only be confirmed, approved or paid within 72 hours of its creation. After that it lapses and a new one is needed (refund-policy/v2/validity).

I've made a new proposal for the Glass coffee carafe (order h402-o1). The refund is BRL 119.90, which is what you paid for it (refund-policy/v2/amount). To confirm it, use the button on the proposal card. Typing "yes" in the chat doesn't confirm it. A staff member then has to approve it (refund-policy/v2/approval). Please confirm soon, because this proposal also expires 72 hours after it was created.

You asked about debit card payments. Your order has one valid payment record, so a refund can be paid automatically, and only to that original payment (refund-policy/v2/payment). I can't see which payment method you used, and that rule applies to any valid payment method. Payment still needs your confirmation and staff approval. The receipt records the refund in the shop's test ledger. It isn't a bank transfer, and the shop gives no date for the money to appear on a card (refund-policy/v2/payout).
Your refund has been paid. It is BRL 119.90 for the Glass coffee carafe, and the receipt number is R-00000001. The refund is recorded against the order's original payment.
